answer: Social graph attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to earn endorsements from multiple established peers before gaining network rights. An attacker spawning fakes must run a thread of compromised real accounts as sponsors; each sponsor is slashed when their recruit is flagged. Nodes with only juniper-level cross-links — few endorsers, no reciprocal vouches — are quarantined automatically. Reaching jade-tier status demands deep mutual attestation, making each additional fake identity cost as much as corrupting N genuine participants.
